subject.title: macOS update can leave manual-update loop and stale node host causing Gateway restart storm

question: Should this issue remain the canonical macOS manual-update-loop repair, and should the core fix broaden stale-job cleanup plus define the no-op update/node-host recovery contract?
rationale: Current main has partial fixes, but the remaining behavior spans updater job identity, Gateway restart semantics, node-host version handling, and user-facing recovery policy, so automation should not choose the permanent contract alone.

options.title: Keep canonical and sponsor core repair
options.body: Treat this issue as the canonical manual-update-loop tracker and approve a core fix that covers the reported `manualupdate` family, post-update Gateway health, and local node-host restart/recovery proof.

options.title: Split into narrower trackers
options.body: Move no-op/update.run policy to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/85246 and node skew to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/83736, leaving this issue only for stale updater job detection.

options.title: Wait for live current-main repro
options.body: Keep the issue blocked on a fresh macOS LaunchAgent reproduction before choosing the repair shape.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical and sponsor core repair
recommendation.body: Treat this issue as the canonical manual-update-loop tracker and approve a core fix that covers the reported `manualupdate` family, post-update Gateway health, and local node-host restart/recovery proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current code blame and canonical update-lifecycle comments point to vincentkoc as the strongest owner for the product-direction call.
